name: Being Deceived
overview: Scripture warns believers to be vigilant against deception, emphasizing that merely professing faith is insufficient without doing the will of God (Matthew 7:21). The devil, described as the father of lies, actively deceives the world and leads people away from truth (John 8:44; Revelation 12:9). Christians are exhorted to avoid those who promote false teachings and divisions contrary to sound doctrine (Romans 16:17) and to beware of philosophies and traditions that seduce away from Christ (Colossians 2:8). Ultimately, God’s justice prevails, as those who sow deceit will reap its consequences (Galatians 6:7).
